name: atlas
description: A self-syncing per-topic documentation wiki for LLM consumption — docs declare the files they cover, drift is detected mechanically against a git rev anchor, and stale docs can be auto-fixed before a push

interface.shortDescription: Per-topic docs that stay in sync with the code.
interface.longDescription: Atlas turns a repository's knowledge into a per-topic wiki an agent can navigate by index instead of cramming into CLAUDE.md. Each doc's frontmatter declares `covers` globs and a `code_rev` anchor, so staleness is a mechanical glob match over `git diff --name-only` with no model pass. Drift detection and the INDEX generator are plain Python; the push-time auto-fix is Claude Code-only and off by default, so this Codex manifest exposes the doc model, the validator and the drift detector.
defaultPrompt: Check which atlas docs have drifted from the code.
